project_name.justification: The article states, 'CBLT Inc. (TSXV: CBLT) ("CBLT" or "the Company") is very pleased to announce it has purchased the Falcon Gold property, host to the former Falcon Gold Mine, in Sudbury, Ontario ("Falcon" or "the Property")...'

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified as 'CBLT Inc. (TSXV: CBLT) ("CBLT" or "the Company") is very pleased to announce it has purchased the Falcon Gold property...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The contact information section lists 'Peter M. Clausi CEO and Director'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The article states CBLT 'purchased the Falcon Gold property', which implies 100% interest, but an explicit percentage is not mentioned.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is referred to as the 'Falcon Gold Mine' and the article headline is 'CBLT Acquires Falcon Gold Mine with Historical Resource Estimate'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'CBLT Acquires Falcon Gold Mine with Historical Resource Estimate' and details the acquisition of the Falcon project by CBLT Inc., which matches the project of interest.

currency.justification: The article does not provide any financial details of the transaction, so the currency cannot be determined.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The article announces the purchase but does not specify any cash consideration.

share_payments_raw.justification: The article announces the purchase but does not specify any share consideration.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The article does not provide a combined value for the transaction.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The article does not mention any shares being issued as part of the acquisition.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The article does not mention any share warrant payments as part of the acquisition.

option_payments_raw.justification: The article does not mention any option payments as part of the acquisition.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The article mentions a 'summer work program' but does not quantify an exploration commitment in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The article mentions a 'summer work program' but does not quantify a monetary exploration commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The article does not mention any Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) being acquired or retained as part of the transaction.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The article states the property 'comprises a contiguous block of 3 patented claims' but does not provide a specific area in units like hectares or km2.

coverage_area_unit.justification: No coverage area value was provided, so no unit can be extracted.

resource_size.justification: The article states, 'In 1988, Falconbridge completed a 24-hole, 14 951-foot drill program which increased the mineral inventory of the Falcon deposit to 59 400 tons grading 0.226 oz Au/ton...'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The article identifies the buyer as 'CBLT Inc. (TSXV: CBLT)'.
